newsitem.title: PERU: Two hurt in shoot-out near Japan embassy in Peru.
newsitem.headline: Two hurt in shoot-out near Japan embassy in Peru.

text.p: Two men were injured in a shoot-out with police near the Japanese embassy in Lima on Sunday, but the incident was unrelated to the hostage crisis at the nearby Japanese ambassador's residence, officials said.
"They were common criminals," a police spokesman said, adding that shots were fired after police approached a group of suspicious-looking men about a city block from the embassy.
Local radio said four of the men were detained, two with injuries, and that two escaped.
The Japanese embassy is less than a mile (about one km) away from the besieged residence where Marxist rebels are holding 73 hostages. The siege was in its 33rd day Sunday.
